assessment: FLT3 (Fms-related receptor tyrosine kinase 3) activation occurs in a subset of AML cases and is associated with poor prognosis. This work is focused on the mechanisms of resistance to FLT3 inhibitors in AML. The authors show that the combination of the FLT3 inhibitor and an mTORC1 inhibitor reduces tumor burden and prevents relapse in FLT3 mutant AML. This article is of interest to scientists and physicians investigating AML as well as scientists studying signaling pathways.
